Definition
1. ch4:4.3\group ch04-poisson-newtonian-potential Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0064 For $0<\alpha <1$, a function $f$ on bounded $D i x_0$ is $\alpha $-Hölder continuous at $x_0$ when egin{equation} ag {4.3} [f]_{\alpha ;x_0}=\sup _{x\in D,\, x eq x_0} rac{|f(x)-f(x_0)|}{|x-x_0|^\alpha }<\infty . \end{equation} For $\alpha =1$ this is pointwise Lipschitz continuity.
